title: Fix Arc Preview and Output
description: The arc command doesn't preview correctly (no curve rendering for arc/circle-outline preview kinds) and produces wrong output (kernel reads radiusPoint instead of start)
summary: Interactive resize now applies uniform CSS scale to disposition content from its natural/declared baseline so text and figures zoom inside the frame instead of reflowing and overshooting. Single-axis handle drags scale along that axis; dual-axis resize uses min(scaleX, scaleY) to avoid overflow.
